{"id":1536003193,"question_id":3434,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1739033664,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"187 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1536003193/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Number of Distinct Colors Among the Balls","memory":"172 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> queryResults(int limit, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        unordered_map<int,int>balls_map;\n        unordered_map<int,int> colour;\n        vector<int>ans;\n\n        for(auto  mark : queries)\n        {\n            int ball = mark[0];\n            int color = mark[1];\n\n            if(balls_map.find(ball) == balls_map.end())\n            {\n                balls_map[ball] = color;\n\n                int old_color = balls_map[ball];\n                colour[old_color]++;  \n            }\n            else\n            {\n                colour[balls_map[ball]]--;\n\n                if(colour[balls_map[ball]]==0)\n                colour.erase(balls_map[ball]);\n\n                balls_map[ball] = color;\n                colour[color]++;\n            }\n            \n            ans.push_back(colour.size());\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-number-of-distinct-colors-among-the-balls","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":300}
